    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # The pattern is the non-background object, and the zero block marks its destination.
    bg = g[0][0]
    obj = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (bg, 0)]
    # Include any non-background pattern color (the ARC pattern is surrounded by bg).
    if not obj:
        return g
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in obj), max(r for r, c in obj)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in obj), max(c for r, c in obj)
    zeros = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == 0]
    if not zeros:
        return g
    z0, z1 = min(r for r, c in zeros), max(r for r, c in zeros)
    x0, x1 = min(c for r, c in zeros), max(c for r, c in zeros)
    # Mirror the whole pattern horizontally into the zero-marked rectangle.
    for dr in range(z1 - z0 + 1):
        for dc in range(x1 - x0 + 1):
            sr, sc = r0 + dr, c1 - dc
            g[z0 + dr][x0 + dc] = g[sr][sc]
    return g
